BiblicalUsage: Magpiash is named once, in Nehemiah 10:20, in the list of those who sealed the covenant after the return, between Meshullam and Hezir. He sealed the covenant with the rest of the returned exiles, and his name stands between Meshullam and Hezir.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that a signature on a covenant is a small thing and a great one: Magpiash put his name where his people put theirs.
